mr_title: refactor(@angular-devkit/build-angular): use Node.js promise fs API in service-worker augmentation
mr_description:
With the minimum version of Node.js now set to v12, the promise fs API can now be leveraged within the tooling.
This change also uses `copyFile` (with copy-on-write where available) to setup the the service worker files as well a streaming APIs to generate service worker hashes. Both of which improves performance and reduces memory usage.

expected_issues.title: POSIX path functions applied to native Windows paths
expected_issues.description:
path.posix.relative/join are applied to native file-system paths, which on Windows contain drive letters and backslashes, producing '../C:\...' entries, so the generated ngsw.json caches no assets on Windows.

`this.base` and `dir` come from the OS (e.g. C:\project\dist). POSIX path functions do not understand them, so relative() yields paths outside the base and the service-worker config generator matches no files. Native path functions must be used and the result normalised to forward slashes.
